en.headline: AFCD captures several nuisance monkeys near Cross Harbour Tunnel bus interchange
en.dek: The Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department said dedicated teams caught multiple aggressive monkeys that had been snatching food and items from people over the past two weeks.
body: The Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department said it had captured several nuisance monkeys near the Cross Harbour Tunnel bus interchange and Harcourt Road after receiving multiple reports of disturbances in recent months.

Dedicated teams monitored the areas daily over the past two weeks at the interchange, school entrances, residential estates and nearby bus stops, driving away or catching monkeys during peak activity periods and installing large traps as needed. Among those captured were aggressive animals that regularly snatched food and belongings from people at the interchange.

The department also distributed leaflets reminding residents, students and passengers not to eat in front of monkeys, to secure food and plastic bags, and to dispose of rubbish properly. It said the situation at both locations had improved noticeably and that monitoring would continue.

The sites are close to country park areas where monkeys live, and the department urged the public not to feed them, noting that feeding wild monkeys is illegal and can attract a fixed penalty of HK$5,000.

zh.headline: 漁護署在城門隧道轉車站及郝德傑道捕捉多隻滋事猴子
zh.dek: 漁農自然護理署表示過去兩星期專責隊伍成功捕獲多隻具攻擊性、經常搶奪市民食物及物品的猴子，並增設大型捕捉籠。
body: 漁農自然護理署表示，近月接獲多宗城門隧道轉車站及郝德傑道一帶猴子滋擾報告後，已加強巡查、驅趕及捕捉工作，成功捕獲多隻滋事猴子。
署方過去兩星期派出專責隊伍每日在轉車站、學校出入口、住宅屋苑及附近巴士站監察猴子活動，在頻繁出沒時段即時驅趕或捕捉，並增設大型捕捉籠。被捕獲的包括經常在轉車站搶奪市民食物及物品、具攻擊性的猴子。
漁護署亦向居民、學生及乘客派發宣傳小冊子，提醒避免在猴子面前進食、妥善收好食物及膠袋，以及妥善棄置垃圾。署方指經過一連串措施，兩個地點的滋擾情況已明顯改善，將繼續監察。
由於地點鄰近猴子棲息的郊野地區，署方呼籲市民切勿餵飼猴子，指餵飼野生猴子屬違法行為，可被處以五千元定額罰款。
